newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North Q1 net profit A$15.3 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North Q1 net profit A$15.3 million.

text.p: Mining and forestry group North Ltd said on Friday it recorded a A$15.3 million net operating profit for the three months to September 30 compared to a profit of A$20.0 million in the previous corresponding quarter.

North said the result was lower largely due to an increased tax expense reflecting reduced research and development allowances and the non-deductability of amortisation of the Zinkgruvan mining rights in Sweden.
The company also noted that operating performance in some of its businesses was significantly affected by the timing of shipments on a quarter to quarter basis.
By 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT), North shares were three cents higher at A$3.67 on turnover of 256,397 shares.
